result.title: Video Generalized Category Discovery
result.summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to categorize unlabeled data from both known and unknown classes using labeled data from only the known classes. While recent GCD methods have shown promise on static images, their performance degrades in videos due to temporal dynamics, larger intra-class variation, and the lack of temporal consistency in existing approaches. We introduce VideoGCD, a framework tailored for video action recognition under the GCD setting. Our method integrates (i) a partitioned Mixture-of-Experts module that encourages specialization for known and novel categories, (ii) a novel-class balancing loss to reduce bias toward known classes, and (iii) a temporal optimal transport loss that promotes consistent routing across frames. Experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoGCD significantly improves performance over existing GCD methods, particularly on novel categories. Our findings highlight the importance of combining temporal modeling and expert specialization for video GCD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VideoGCD 框架，用于视频动作识别中的广义类别发现：用分块 MoE 促使已知类与新类专家分化，配以新类平衡损失缓解对已知类的偏置，并用时序最优传输损失约束跨帧路由一致。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用最优传输在时间维度上约束「路由/表征分配一致、并抑制多数类偏置」的做法，可能可供核查为多步 latent 推理状态一致性与专家贡献分配的迁移线索；但它本身是视频分类任务，与视觉推理证据使用的联系尚不明确。
